turns.message: 请详细一点，解释新会话会保留哪些数据。这不是永久设置。

initial.reply:
### 政策说明

新建会话不会清空订单等业务数据，长期偏好也会保留。具体来说：

- **业务数据**：订单等业务数据保留，不会因新建会话而清空。
- **长期偏好**：保留；如需删除，可在记忆页删除对应类别，或明确要求忘记。
- **历史记录**：页面展示最近 50 条请求，模型读取最近 6 个完成轮次。
- **客户编号**：只是本地演示身份，用于开始对话。

另外，新建会话不会自动发送通知，目前也没有真实通知渠道。

问：如何开始使用？答：选择客户编号，在客服对话输入问题；客户编号只是本地演示身份。
问：为什么不能继续输入？答：请先完成当前选单、支付方式或逐项确认。
问：聊天说确认会执行吗？答：不会，资金动作必须使用按钮。
问：新建会话会清空订单吗？答：不会，业务数据和长期偏好保留。

问：如何查看规则全文？答：打开平台资料详情页按分类或商品查找。
问：如何更新知识库？答：停止应用，修改目录及manifest.json，运行目录导入命令后重启。
问：导入需要什么？答：本地Qdrant和缓存的多语言E5；首次下载需要联网。
问：删除数据库后怎么办？答：启动会创建新业务与记忆库并初始化十笔样例订单；知识库需要重新导入。
问：技术失败会转人工吗？答：不会，只有明确要求人工或投诉才创建本地工单。
问：联系偏好会发消息吗？答：不会，目前没有真实通知渠道。

# POL-101 支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请

> 虚构平台的模拟政策，用于客服检索测试，不代表现实商家或法律规定。

## 适用范围
本条属于“无理由退货”分类，适用于本模拟平台的零售交易与客服解释。

## 具体规定
支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请。

## 处理与核实
涉及具体订单时，先核对本人订单、商品身份与当前业务记录；解释规则不等于已经完成办理。用户应保留与本条事项直接相关的页面、物流或支付凭证，避免提交无关个人信息。

## 例外与边界
如商品详情存在经明确展示的专门条款，应同时核实其适用条件；资料缺失或冲突时说明待核实内容，不自行承诺。现有本地执行工具的资格判断与按钮确认仍独立生效。

结论：支持无理由退货的商品，须在签收后七日内提出申请[6c35037b-2cb5-5d64-b578-207e63f60959]；定制商品不适用普通无理由退货，质量问题另行处理[3a796bae-9510-55cb-b305-4946b75837c9]。

补充说明：
- 七日规则是模拟平台规则，本地资格程序未实现期限检查[910c100c-9514-52a2-819c-6235c3ccda23]。
- 无理由退货还要求商品保持完好、不影响再次销售[4e5be120-20ca-5966-81f4-413806aa3180]；退货应包含附件、赠品与可识别的商品主体[0da6167a-3f50-5d2d-ae7d-f916ddc6910a]。
- 普通无理由退货运费原则上由买家承担[bb316664-b443-53c7-aca0-32cd916e8a9f]；退款到账时间取决于支付渠道，不能统一承诺固定天数[99019f5f-703d-533a-886c-5a5d6a557d3c]。
- 定制订单开始生产后取消，可能产生已确认的合理费用[307287c7-4531-513c-a3d7-ad7cc863aa38]。

以上为规则解释，不代表已为具体订单办理退货或退款。

# POL-101 支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请

> 虚构平台的模拟政策，用于客服检索测试，不代表现实商家或法律规定。

## 适用范围
本条属于“无理由退货”分类，适用于本模拟平台的零售交易与客服解释。

## 具体规定
支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请。

## 处理与核实
涉及具体订单时，先核对本人订单、商品身份与当前业务记录；解释规则不等于已经完成办理。用户应保留与本条事项直接相关的页面、物流或支付凭证，避免提交无关个人信息。

补充说明：

### 综合说明

可以给你一个政策分类概览，但这份资料每类只选了一条示例，不是全部规则，因此不能说明已覆盖每条规则的全部细节。

资料涉及的政策分类及示例：
- 账户与身份：注册使用可接收验证码的手机号或邮箱；同一联系方式仅绑定一个主账户[0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5]
- 下单与库存：加入购物车不锁定库存，以提交订单时的可售数量为准[2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c]
- 价格与促销：结算价格以提交订单的商品明细为准，历史截图不能单独证明成交价[0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4]
- 优惠券：每笔订单最多使用一张平台优惠券[03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a]
- 支付与安全：支持的付款渠道以结算页面选项为准[73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff]
- 配送范围：以收货地区校验结果为准[2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a]
- 发货与时效：现货订单一般在付款后两个工作日内安排出库，节假日另计[e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c]
- 地址与改派：付款前可在结算页修改收货地址[5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d]
- 签收与验货：签收前检查外包装是否破损、浸水或明显挤压[0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c]
- 取消订单：待付款订单可在平台订单页申请取消[99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305]
- 无理由退货：支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请[ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb]
- 质量售后：功能故障应先排查使用环境与说明书要求[eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478]
- 退货物流：通过售后单确认退货地址后再寄回[6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a]
- 退款进度：退款申请提交后先进行资格和材料审核[53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a]
- 换货与维修：换货需先核实库存与原商品故障情况[4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d]
- 发票与凭证：发票抬头应在申请时准确填写[acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2]
- 隐私与资料：只收集完成订单及售后所需的必要信息[d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5]
- 商品描述与兼容：商品编号用于区分不同型号，外观相似不代表规格一致[8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb]
- 评价与内容：评价应基于实际交易体验，不得发布他人隐私[d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329]
- 客服与争议：查询订单应提供订单号，系统仅返回本人可访问记录[4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303]

sources.title: 账户与身份：注册使用可接收验证码的手机号或邮箱
sources.content:
## 具体规定
注册使用可接收验证码的手机号或邮箱；同一联系方式仅绑定一个主账户。

sources.title: 下单与库存：加入购物车不锁定库存
sources.content:
## 具体规定
加入购物车不锁定库存；以提交订单时的可售数量为准。

sources.title: 价格与促销：结算价格以提交订单的商品明细为准
sources.content:
## 具体规定
结算价格以提交订单的商品明细为准；历史截图不能单独证明成交价。

sources.title: 优惠券：每笔订单最多使用一张平台优惠券
sources.content:
## 具体规定
每笔订单最多使用一张平台优惠券。

sources.title: 支付与安全：支持的付款渠道以结算页面选项为准
sources.content:
## 具体规定
支持的付款渠道以结算页面选项为准。

sources.title: 配送范围：配送范围须以收货地区校验结果为准
sources.content:
## 具体规定
配送范围须以收货地区校验结果为准。

sources.title: 发货与时效：现货订单一般在付款后两个工作日内安排出库，节假日另计
sources.content:
## 具体规定
现货订单一般在付款后两个工作日内安排出库，节假日另计。

sources.title: 地址与改派：付款前可在结算页修改收货地址
sources.content:
## 具体规定
付款前可在结算页修改收货地址。

sources.title: 签收与验货：签收前检查外包装是否破损、浸水或明显挤压
sources.content:
## 具体规定
签收前检查外包装是否破损、浸水或明显挤压。

sources.title: 取消订单：待付款订单可在平台订单页申请取消
sources.content:
## 具体规定
待付款订单可在平台订单页申请取消。

sources.title: 无理由退货：支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请
sources.content:
## 具体规定
支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请。

sources.title: 质量售后：功能故障应先排查使用环境与说明书要求
sources.content:
## 具体规定
功能故障应先排查使用环境与说明书要求。

sources.title: 退货物流：通过售后单确认退货地址后再寄回
sources.content:
## 具体规定
通过售后单确认退货地址后再寄回。

sources.title: 退款进度：退款申请提交后先进行资格和材料审核
sources.content:
## 具体规定
退款申请提交后先进行资格和材料审核。

sources.title: 换货与维修：换货需先核实库存与原商品故障情况
sources.content:
## 具体规定
换货需先核实库存与原商品故障情况。

sources.title: 发票与凭证：发票抬头应在申请时准确填写
sources.content:
## 具体规定
发票抬头应在申请时准确填写。

sources.title: 隐私与资料：只收集完成订单及售后所需的必要信息
sources.content:
## 具体规定
只收集完成订单及售后所需的必要信息。

sources.title: 商品描述与兼容：商品编号用于区分不同型号，外观相似不代表规格一致
sources.content:
## 具体规定
商品编号用于区分不同型号，外观相似不代表规格一致。

sources.title: 评价与内容：评价应基于实际交易体验，不得发布他人隐私
sources.content:
## 具体规定
评价应基于实际交易体验，不得发布他人隐私。

sources.title: 客服与争议：查询订单应提供订单号，系统仅返回本人可访问记录
sources.content:
## 具体规定
查询订单应提供订单号，系统仅返回本人可访问记录。

turns.message: Hello. Please explain how order queries differ from financial actions. Answer in English this turn.

initial.reply:
Hi! In short: order queries are read-only lookups, while financial actions change money or payment state.

- Order queries (order list, details, status, shipment, payment status) just retrieve information about your orders. They don't change anything.
- Financial actions (preparing a payment, checking refund eligibility, preparing a refund) are steps that can lead to money moving. They require your clear intent, and preparation and final confirmation are kept as separate steps.

tasks.source_text: How many days after delivery can I request a no-reason return? Are customized products excluded?
tasks.answer:
You can request a no-reason return within seven days after delivery [6c35037b-2cb5-5d64-b578-207e63f60959]. Yes, customized products are excluded: they do not qualify for ordinary no-reason returns, and quality issues are handled separately [3a796bae-9510-55cb-b305-4946b75837c9]. Note that the seven-day rule is a simulated platform rule, and the local eligibility tool does not implement a deadline check [910c100c-9514-52a2-819c-6235c3ccda23].

# POL-101 支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请

> 虚构平台的模拟政策，用于客服检索测试，不代表现实商家或法律规定。

## 适用范围
本条属于“无理由退货”分类，适用于本模拟平台的零售交易与客服解释。

## 具体规定
支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请。

## 处理与核实
涉及具体订单时，先核对本人订单、商品身份与当前业务记录；解释规则不等于已经完成办理。用户应保留与本条事项直接相关的页面、物流或支付凭证，避免提交无关个人信息。

## 例外与边界
如商品详情存在经明确展示的专门条款，应同时核实其适用条件；资料缺失或冲突时说明待核实内容，不自行承诺。现有本地执行工具的资格判断与按钮确认仍独立生效。

tasks.source_text: How many days after delivery can I request a no-reason return? Are customized products excluded?
tasks.answer:
You can request a no-reason return within seven days after delivery [6c35037b-2cb5-5d64-b578-207e63f60959]. Yes, customized products are excluded: they do not qualify for ordinary no-reason returns, and quality issues are handled separately [3a796bae-9510-55cb-b305-4946b75837c9]. Note that the seven-day rule is a simulated platform rule, and the local eligibility tool does not implement a deadline check [910c100c-9514-52a2-819c-6235c3ccda23].

initial.reply:
### 综合说明

Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the materials:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove the transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the result of the delivery-area check [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two working days after payment; holidays are counted separately [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing whether the outer packaging is damaged, soaked, or visibly crushed [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].

Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the materials:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove the transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the result of the delivery-area check [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two working days after payment; holidays are counted separately [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing whether the outer packaging is damaged, soaked, or visibly crushed [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].
- **Quality after-sales (POL-111):** For functional faults, first check the usage environment and manual requirements [eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478].
- **Return logistics (POL-121):** Confirm the return address through the after-sales order before sending items back [6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a].
- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require first verifying stock and the original item's fault [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & documents (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only information necessary to complete orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].
- **Product description & compatibility (POL-171):** Item numbers distinguish models; similar appearance does not mean identical specifications [8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb].
- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not publish others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system returns only records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

Note: this is a categorized overview with one example per category, not the complete rule set; full rules are available on the platform materials detail page by category.

result.answer:
Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the materials:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove the transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the result of the delivery-area check [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two working days after payment; holidays are counted separately [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing whether the outer packaging is damaged, soaked, or visibly crushed [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].
- **Quality after-sales (POL-111):** For functional faults, first check the usage environment and manual requirements [eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478].
- **Return logistics (POL-121):** Confirm the return address through the after-sales order before sending items back [6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a].
- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require first verifying stock and the original item's fault [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & documents (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only information necessary to complete orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].
- **Product description & compatibility (POL-171):** Item numbers distinguish models; similar appearance does not mean identical specifications [8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb].
- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not publish others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system returns only records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

Note: this is a categorized overview with one example per category, not the complete rule set; full rules are available on the platform materials detail page by category.

final.reply:
### 综合说明

Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the materials:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove the transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the result of the delivery-area check [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two working days after payment; holidays are counted separately [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing whether the outer packaging is damaged, soaked, or visibly crushed [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].
- **Quality after-sales (POL-111):** For functional faults, first check the usage environment and manual requirements [eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478].
- **Return logistics (POL-121):** Confirm the return address through the after-sales order before sending items back [6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a].
- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require first verifying stock and the original item's fault [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & documents (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only information necessary to complete orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].
- **Product description & compatibility (POL-171):** Item numbers distinguish models; similar appearance does not mean identical specifications [8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb].
- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not publish others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system returns only records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

Note: this is a categorized overview with one example per category, not the complete rule set; full rules are available on the platform materials detail page by category.

tasks.source_text: Give me an overview of all platform policies.
tasks.answer:
Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the materials:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove the transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the result of the delivery-area check [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two working days after payment; holidays are counted separately [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing whether the outer packaging is damaged, soaked, or visibly crushed [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].
- **Quality after-sales (POL-111):** For functional faults, first check the usage environment and manual requirements [eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478].
- **Return logistics (POL-121):** Confirm the return address through the after-sales order before sending items back [6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a].
- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require first verifying stock and the original item's fault [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & documents (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only information necessary to complete orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].
- **Product description & compatibility (POL-171):** Item numbers distinguish models; similar appearance does not mean identical specifications [8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb].
- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not publish others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system returns only records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

Note: this is a categorized overview with one example per category, not the complete rule set; full rules are available on the platform materials detail page by category.

result.message: 这是分类概览，每类仅选一条示例，不是全部规则。完整规则请在平台资料详情页按分类查看。

result.answer:
Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the materials:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove the transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the result of the delivery-area check [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two working days after payment; holidays are counted separately [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing whether the outer packaging is damaged, soaked, or visibly crushed [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].
- **Quality after-sales (POL-111):** For functional faults, first check the usage environment and manual requirements [eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478].
- **Return logistics (POL-121):** Confirm the return address through the after-sales order before sending items back [6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a].
- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require first verifying stock and the original item's fault [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & documents (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only information necessary to complete orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].
- **Product description & compatibility (POL-171):** Item numbers distinguish models; similar appearance does not mean identical specifications [8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb].
- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not publish others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system returns only records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

Note: this is a categorized overview with one example per category, not the complete rule set; full rules are available on the platform materials detail page by category.

### 综合说明

# POL-195 争议材料应包括订单、问题描述和相关凭证

> 虚构平台的模拟政策，用于客服检索测试，不代表现实商家或法律规定。

## 适用范围
本条属于“客服与争议”分类，适用于本模拟平台的零售交易与客服解释。

## 具体规定
争议材料应包括订单、问题描述和相关凭证。

## 处理与核实
涉及具体订单时，先核对本人订单、商品身份与当前业务记录；解释规则不等于已经完成办理。用户应保留与本条事项直接相关的页面、物流或支付凭证，避免提交无关个人信息。

## 例外与边界
如商品详情存在经明确展示的专门条款，应同时核实其适用条件；资料缺失或冲突时说明待核实内容，不自行承诺。现有本地执行工具的资格判断与按钮确认仍独立生效。

tasks.source_text: The service is disappointing, but only explain how to complain.
tasks.answer:
To complain, submit a formal complaint with the order number, a clear description of the problem, and supporting evidence such as relevant page, logistics, or payment records [eb29a4fb-cbda-5bc4-a076-73f4952583dd]. A ticket can only be created after you explicitly request a human agent or a formal complaint [edcc0a0e-9696-5af2-aeae-2d2916f02136]. If the issue involves misleading advertising, you can also submit the specific link and evidence for review [2484a2e7-3ca7-5a5d-9d3e-4baa16cc7762]. As requested, no ticket was created and no human was contacted.

sources.title: 午后风劲云舒寒意浓 双休日天气新更出炉！
sources.content:
今天是2026年11月20日 星期五 农历 十月十二

午后风劲云舒寒意浓 双休日天气新更出炉！

受补充冷空气影响，今天白天大风自西向东逐渐加大，午后大部分地区有3、4级偏北风，阵风6、7级，西部山区局地可达8级以上。

北京市气象台已于昨日19时45分继续发布大风蓝色预警信号，请注意防范。

强劲的北风吹拂之下，片片云团点缀长空，云与蓝天相映，视野疏朗。不过凛冽北风加持下，风寒效应十分突出，体感寒意远重于实际气温，大家外出要注意添衣保暖，谨防着凉感冒。

双休日正赶上明显冷空气的间歇期，终于没有了风雨（雪）的侵扰，晴好天气稳稳上线。阳光相伴、风力不大，午间非常适合出门散步、晒太阳。需要注意的是，虽然阳光明媚，但气温仍然持续较低，尤其早晚期间，寒意更浓，大家外出及时添衣。

根据最新的气象资料分析，未来一周大部分时间是晴到多云的天气，没有明显雨雪过程，23日、27日前后受冷空气影响，北风较大，请及时关注临近预报预警信息，提前做好防范措施。

...

sources.title: 午后风劲云舒寒意浓 双休日天气新更出炉！
sources.content:
今天是2026年11月20日 星期五 农历 十月十二

北京市气象台已于昨日19时45分继续发布大风蓝色预警信号，请注意防范。

双休日正赶上明显冷空气的间歇期，终于没有了风雨（雪）的侵扰，晴好天气稳稳上线。阳光相伴、风力不大，午间非常适合出门散步、晒太阳。需要注意的是，虽然阳光明媚，但气温仍然持续较低，尤其早晚期间，寒意更浓，大家外出及时添衣。

根据最新的气象资料分析，未来一周大部分时间是晴到多云的天气，没有明显雨雪过程，23日、27日前后受冷空气影响，北风较大，请及时关注临近预报预警信息，提前做好防范措施。

sources.content:
# 大風預警生效中！北京今天北風仍強勁 雙休日晴天為主適宜出行

來源：央視網 | 2026年11月20日 10:09:48
...
央視網消息：據中國天氣網消息，受補充冷空氣影響，今天（11月20日）白天，北京市風力仍強勁，大部分地區有3至4級偏北風，陣風可達6至7級，風寒效應顯著。目前，北京市大風藍色預警信號仍在生效中。雙休日北京將以晴天為主，風力減小，適宜戶外活動。
...
受補充冷空氣影響，今天白天，北京風力仍然較大，夜間風力將明顯減弱。根據北京市氣象台最新預報，今天白天，北京多雲轉晴，偏北風1級轉3至4級（陣風6至7級），最高氣溫9℃；夜間晴，偏北風1至2級，最低氣溫-2℃。
...
中國天氣網提醒，雙休日北京將以晴天為主，風力不大，適宜出行及戶外活動。但氣溫偏低，一早一晚寒意十足，市民外出需注意防寒保暖，謹防心腦血管和呼吸系統疾病發生。

The weekend is forecast to be sunny with no wind, rain, or snow, and the coming week is mostly clear to cloudy with no obvious rain/snow [bj.weather.com.cn; cctv.com].

**Order 1010:** The available order information shows it as shipped and in transit. The sources do not include any delivery record, delay notice, or weather-related exception for this order.

**Does rain prove this order was delayed by weather?** No. First, the Beijing sources do not report rain on 20 November — they report wind and clear/cloudy conditions. Second, even if there had been rain, weather alone would not prove this specific order was delayed: that would require the order's own logistics records showing a weather-related delay. The materials contain no such record, so a weather-caused delay for order 1010 cannot be confirmed from these sources.

sources.title: 午后风劲云舒寒意浓 双休日天气新更出炉！
sources.content:
今天是2026年11月20日 星期五 农历 十月十二

午后风劲云舒寒意浓 双休日天气新更出炉！

受补充冷空气影响，今天白天大风自西向东逐渐加大，午后大部分地区有3、4级偏北风，阵风6、7级，西部山区局地可达8级以上。

北京市气象台已于昨日19时45分继续发布大风蓝色预警信号，请注意防范。

强劲的北风吹拂之下，片片云团点缀长空，云与蓝天相映，视野疏朗。不过凛冽北风加持下，风寒效应十分突出，体感寒意远重于实际气温，大家外出要注意添衣保暖，谨防着凉感冒。

双休日正赶上明显冷空气的间歇期，终于没有了风雨（雪）的侵扰，晴好天气稳稳上线。阳光相伴、风力不大，午间非常适合出门散步、晒太阳。需要注意的是，虽然阳光明媚，但气温仍然持续较低，尤其早晚期间，寒意更浓，大家外出及时添衣。

根据最新的气象资料分析，未来一周大部分时间是晴到多云的天气，没有明显雨雪过程，23日、27日前后受冷空气影响，北风较大，请及时关注临近预报预警信息，提前做好防范措施。
